# Getting Started with OpenCV: A Practical Introduction

Image arrays, file I/O, video capture, and keyboard and mouse interaction in OpenCV.

[Read the issue](https://newsletter.francofernando.com/p/getting-started-with-opencv-a-practical).

[The Polymathic Engineer](https://newsletter.francofernando.com) | [Subscribe](https://newsletter.francofernando.com/subscribe)

## Run

Python 3.10+ with NumPy and OpenCV. Examples 03-05 need a camera; 03-06 need a display.

From this folder:

```sh
python -m pip install numpy opencv-python
python 01_image_basics.py
python 02_read_write_images.py
python 03_video_capture.py
python 04_video_writer.py
python 05_display_keyboard.py
python 06_mouse_callback.py
```
